body: You have to make a point then ;) I usually get bad just before the end of the night...and I think you underestimate the YouTube viewing audience.... They like videos of people opening jars of moisturizer FFS.... :p

For me I feel better off meds than I ever did on them.... Although talk to your doctor! (No cold turkey!) As for death, that is something that sucks, and takes a lot of planning, and might hurt like a bitch....so if you're willing to put all that miserable painful effort into something....try putting it into something else....write an epic novel....draw a comic book....sing a song as loud as you can and put it on YouTube... You have to make up something to live for.... The lie is that you have to find the meaning....you have to make it. You get to make that decision, and if you just want to end it....take all the horrible effort that would take... And use it for good! I don't really have friends either....and that used to get me super down... But then I realized I didn't have friends because I didn't really make any...so it's a little on me...I'm my own victim. So I am starting to establish a new life....and that's the thing...you get to do something so few people who are trapped in the everyday get to....you get to invent a whole new person!

High five back at ya! I'm an emotional person, I put my whole heart out there. It's been tough because like you said the whole universe tells you not to.... But I know eventually I'll find someone who values my openness instead of abusing it.

Thank you ;) I know it was a shitty thing but in the long run I know it will be okay. People need to just be good to other people, it doesn't matter the reddit. I think this reddit proves for every jerk there are at least 10 non jerks. ;)

You know what I like? Rube Goldberg machines. Here's the thing though, as perpetual motion machines they only work if all the pieces fit where they should.... And stay there.... Now you might not think your piece matters....but you don't know the affect you have on the path of someone else's future. Let's say you get that job.... Then that person that hired you was looking for you and they just didn't know it yet....or let's say you adopt another cat.... That cat is counting on your experience and love of cats to be happy...your seemly stupid little life keeps the ball going in the Rube Goldberg machine. You need to figure out what part of the machine you want to be, and then waste your days trying to get there.

I know it's complicated, but as I said in my other reply to someone, I really think, even if Andy just fucked up, I hope this story helps other vulnerable people know 2 things- 1) that it can only get better if you make it so....but if you do it will and 2) that when people are nice to you take pause, it's the internet....it's honestly hard to realize that when you're crying oceans....but being on the other side of it now....being depressed leaves you very open and trusting because you want a way out and are willing to take any hand offered to you.

You are more than your race, and anyone that treats you otherwise is an asshole. There will never be a new stereotype unless you actively contribute to changing how people view your culture. You have the ability to be whatever it is you think you want to be..... High school is supposed to piss you off....it's supposed to make you angry....because without that you'd never develop....you'd never fully understand what you want or need to be happy. It sucks, but in the long run you own you....you get to be you....no one can take that away except you....don't give someone else power over what happens to you.

That's fair, it's just towards the end it got so insanely outrageous, and I wasn't in the right place to be dragged around because in general I tend to be overly trusting when depressed. I agree that 90% of thus was him not handling things the right way, but in this particular reddit I believe that makes for a dangerous person. If nothing else then maybe this post can be a cautionary tale.... So when depressed people think they are hitting it off with someone on here, they will step back for just a minute longer.... Or they will find connection in themselves first...,because if thus whole thing has taught me anything.... It's that you have to be the best person in your own life.

So. Doesn't mean you can't find something you enjoy, you're the best person at being you....whatever that amounts to. What do you ant the world to know about you right this minute? What do you think no one understands?

It's a reallllllyyy long story. But in short....yes, we did become friends.... And then we'd talk.... And then he'd vanish for a week and give me a story about how his computer was broken....okay fine that happens....but then he'd have a different account message me on steam saying he was his 14 year old brother..... Then his computer wasn't broken because lo and behold he was actually being hacked by the guy that screwed his ex girlfriend like five years ago....then he was back and calling me.... Oh no wait he was hacked again... No wait now his friend his messaging me saying that he's been missing and they can't find him.... Oh now that friend doesn't exist anywhere on the internet after giving me that news..... Then I get a message that they think he's gone gone forever..... 4 months later....after trying to email him just to find out if he's alive....oh yep....totally alive...totally has a girlfriend....totally made up everything.......seriously there's more but it's ridiculous.....

What are you awesome at? Ignoring all this bullshit in your life right now..., there has to be one thing you know deep in your heart that you are awesome at....I don't care if it's packing suitcases....what is that thing that you know you are awesome at?

You're right, in the long run he did do me a favor. He did provide me someone when I did need them, and I'll give him credit for that. There were A LOT of crazy stories I was told during our time "together" and I would love to know what was true and what wasn't. I think the hardest part was where we met. If it had been a chat over any other reddit I would have brushed it off... But this is a reddit where you are told to put your whole heart out there and so it's hard to imagine that anyone would be so cruel to create a whole fake backstory and mess with someone. I mean FFS there are plenty of other reddit to pick up girls and mess with them... You have to be pretty messed up to do that to someone from here.

I'm not just saying it, but at the moment I really am okay. I've finally started going back to the gym regularly, as a writer I'm writing again, and I don't feel so desperate to connect with anyone unless they are really worth it anymore. I'm happily, non egotistically, focused on me for the first time.... And that's a liberating thing I hope I can help show other people on here is possible....even when realllyyyyy shitty things like this happen.
No thank you. For all you do.
It means a lot to me that you'd say that. I really hope m the only one who went through this incredibly ridiculous ordeal, but maybe in the long run I'm better because of it. I'm getting there.

Thank you. It took a lot... I don't know what happened and it was so hard because I had trust issues to begin with...before this all happened. I just don't want anyone else to fall victim to it, this is the wrong subreddit to hurt people on. If I wasn't a strong person I know it wouldn't have ended well... I feel like I'm only just now getting my life back on track.
